lines.before: **Hard rules:** batch at G3 (triage and diagnose everything, then fix roots). **One sweep** per branch; a high, critical, security or owner-rule fix ships with a failing-first test, a low or medium only if a real input shows it (else `no test: no real input`; rule:test-value); CI runs the full suite and auto-fix handles red. A second pass is the owner's call; escapes are measured next build. Findings are fixed in the build that finds them. A low or medium that cannot be finished carries only on the owner's yes, first next build. A high or critical never carries: it is fixed before the PR (found after it: on its PR), or the owner accepts it.
lines.after: **Hard rules:** batch at G3 (triage and diagnose everything, then fix roots). **One sweep** per branch; a high, critical, security or owner-rule fix ships with a failing-first test, a low or medium only if a real input shows it (else `no test: no real input`; rule:test-value); CI runs the full suite and auto-fix handles red. **The fix check** is that test, failing on the code before its fix, and CI's test check stating its verdict; no agent re-reviews the fixes, and there is no re-sweep. A second sweep is the owner's call; escapes are measured next build. Findings are fixed in the build that finds them. A low or medium that cannot be finished carries only on the owner's yes, first next build. A high or critical never carries: it is fixed before the PR (found after it: on its PR), or the owner accepts it.
lines.why: A2 and A8 (the owner, 2026-11-17, D-3): one sweep and no re-sweep; the fix check is defined once, as each fix's failing-first test and CI's test check

lines.before: - **Reviewers:** a feature PR keeps the Pre-PR Deep Sweep floor; sizing to stakes applies above that floor and to other PRs. Each is held to its step limit; over is a contract miss. Keep the top model as reviewer until the scoreboard shows a cheaper one holds. **Trial (the owner, 2026-10-30):** a role other than security and the novel lens may run on the mid model (the contract's `model`, passed to its Agent call; `pre-pr-sweep/approve.mjs` refuses it on those two); every high finding is re-checked on the top model, and the outcome logs the real findings from mid-model roles (`--real-mid`). It ends when the scoreboard shows the mid model meets the bar, or on a miss.
lines.after: - **Reviewers:** a feature PR keeps the Pre-PR Deep Sweep floor; sizing to stakes applies above that floor and to other PRs. Each is held to its step limit; over is a contract miss. **Reviewer models (the owner, 2026-11-17):** a role runs on the model it names, else the mid model; security and the novel lens run on the top model, and `pre-pr-sweep/approve.mjs` refuses the mid model on them. Every high finding is re-checked on the top model, and the outcome logs the real findings from mid-model roles (`--real-mid`).
lines.why: K114 (the owner, 2026-11-17): the mid-model reviewer trial ends; a role runs on the mid model unless it names one, security and the novel lens on the top model
